card.statement:
An imaginary crystal basis of a reduced imaginary Verma module $\tilde{M}_q(\lambda)$ is a pair $(\mc{L},\mc{B})$ satisfying:

- $\mc{L}$ is an imaginary crystal lattice of $\tilde{M}_q(\lambda)$.

- $\mc{B}$ is a $\C$-basis of $\mc{L}/q\mc{L} \cong \C \otimes_{\mb{A}_0}\mc{L}$.

- $\mc{B} = \cup_{\mu\in\pi} \mc{B}_{\mu}$ where $\mc{B}_{\mu}= \mc{B}\cap(\mc{L}_{\mu}/q\mc{L}_{\mu})$.

- $\tilde{x}_{im}^-\mc{B}\subset \pm\mc{B}\cup \{0\}$ and $\tilde{\Omega}_{\psi_i}(m)\mc{B}\subset \pm\mc{B}\cup \{0\}$, for $i \in I_0$ and $m \in \Z$.

- For $m\in\Z$ and $i\in I_0$ if $\tilde{\Omega}_{\psi_i}(-m)b\neq 0$ and $\tilde{x}_{im}^-b\neq 0$ for $b\in\mc{B}$, then $\tilde{x}_{im}^-\tilde{\Omega}_{\psi_i}(-m)b= \tilde{\Omega}_{\psi_i}(-m)\tilde{x}_{im}^-b$.
card.label: Definition 16

paper.title: Crystal bases for reduced imaginary Verma modules in type $ADE$
paper.abstract: We consider reduced imaginary Verma modules for the untwisted quantum affine algebras $U_q(\hat{\g})$ and define a crystal-like base which we call imaginary crystal base using the Kashiwara algebra $\mathcal K_q$ constructed in earlier work by Ben Cox and two of the authors. We prove the existence of the imaginary crystal base for any object in a suitable category $\mc{O}^q_{red,im}$ containing the reduced imaginary Verma modules for $U_q(\hat{\g})$.
